title: DARPA SID program protection would kill insider threats

tellings.quote: There's the DARPA SID uh if you're considered an insider outsider threat to them, they'll just kill you.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026, says that a part of DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, which he calls SID, will simply kill people it considers a threat from inside or outside. He points to a post he wrote on the subject and links it to a witness named David Grusch. If true, it would mean these secret programmes protect themselves by lethal means.
